verdict.rationale: Justworks documents a first-party Xero integration. Users connect their Xero account, map each Justworks pay type to Chart of Accounts entries with department, office and employee overrides, and can let payroll records sync automatically the day after processing. Missing for 10: any evidence of a QuickBooks integration; confirmation that synced records are journal entries rather than the 'invoices' the docs mention; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero

citations.quote: Before you can start setting up, you’ll first need to connect your Xero account. Clicking “Connect Xero” will redirect you to login to Xero.
you'll need to map each pay type in Justworks to an account or sub-account from your Chart of Accounts in Xero.
Sync method: Manually sync invoices or Allow them to automatically sync the day after processing.
Once you've set up your default company mappings you'll have the option to override the same line items by department to their own accounts in Xero.
